programs.name: Homestead Refund for Disabled Veterans

incomeLimit.quote: You must have household income of $43,389 or less;
incomeLimit.note: TY2025 claim (filed Jan 1 to Apr 15, 2026). 2026 claim-year figure not yet posted.

ratingRequired.quote: has a service-connected evaluation percentage equal to or greater than 50%, pursuant to 38 U.S.C. § 1101 et seq. or 10 U.S.C. § 1201 et seq.

details.correct: Household income cannot exceed $43,389 (TY2025 claim); home appraised value cannot exceed $350,000.
details.quote: Your house cannot be valued at more than $350,000
details.note: $56,450 was the 2024 K-40SVR limit, not a K-40H figure.

survivingSpouse.quote: the surviving spouse of a disabled veteran ... eligible to receive benefits until you remarry

programs.effectiveChanges: No 2026 statutory change: HB 2632 (raise SVR income cap to $75,000 and value cap to $500,000) died in committee; SB 402 (single claim form, higher thresholds, higher max refund) passed Senate and House committee but died without final passage; SB 397 not enacted. TY2026 claim forms post around January 2027.

programs.name: Property Tax Deferral for Service Members
programs.note: No KDOR page or form found; statute (K.S.A. 79-2004 area / deployment deferral) not opened. Deferral only, no savings; leave out of dollar estimate.

programs.name: SVR Property Tax Freeze (K-40SVR, SB 15)

incomeLimit.quote: you must have household income of $58,041 or less for 2025;
incomeLimit.note: Summary text says $53,600 (older). For 2025+ household income means total Kansas AGI of all household members (Social Security excluded).

ratingRequired.quote: A disabled veteran, including those groups and individuals listed under 38 C.F.R. 3.7, for the entire base year

survivingSpouse.quote: Surviving spouses of deceased disabled veterans are also eligible to claim a Property Tax Relief Claim for Seniors and Disabled Veterans refund and remain eligible until such time as they remarry.

summary.correct: household income ≤ $58,041 (2025 claim year, indexed; Kansas AGI basis), home appraised ≤ $350,000 in the base year
summary.quote: your house cannot be valued at more than $350,000 in the base year.

programs.effectiveChanges: No enacted change for 2026. Refund = current-year homestead tax minus base-year tax; base year deemed 2021 if earlier; cannot combine with K-40H or K-40PT in the same year.

summary: Kansas's K-40H ($700 max, $43,389 income, 50%+ rating, $350,000 home) is confirmed for the TY2025 claim, the SVR freeze's income cap is $58,041 (file says $53,600) and the K-40H details text carries a stray $56,450. The 2026 session enacted nothing (HB 2632 and SB 402 died), the deployment deferral row stays unverified, and the 1.41% rate is 0.12 pp above ACS 2024 (1.29%).
